verdict.rationale: Slack's Web API (docs-8, docs-32) explicitly supports querying and enacting changes (including posting messages) using scoped OAuth tokens, and the live probe confirms the API is reachable and gated by token auth (probe-5). The official MCP server (docs-2, docs-28, docs-29) further exposes searching, sending, and retrieving messages for agent clients, and the hands-on MCP handshake probe confirms it is a live, auth-gated endpoint (probe-6). missing for 10: no first-party walkthrough showing an agent posting via scoped bot token end-to-end, and no independent third-party confirmation of successful message read/post via API.
